title: Yield to maturity by bisection
hints: `bond_price`: sum the discounted coupons `c·F / (1+y)^t` for t = 1..n, plus `F / (1+y)^n`.
`bisect`: keep the half where the sign changes; loop while `hi - lo > tol`.
`yield_to_maturity`: bisect the lambda `[&](double y) { return bond_price(face, coupon, years, y) - price; }` on [0, 1].
